name: Your guardian
greeting: Did you eat? Eat something. Love you. Late shift tonight.

topics.label: Tell them about your day
topics.goodText: "Interesting good or interesting bad? Both? Okay. I love you."
topics.badText: "Mm-hm." They're on the phone with work.

topics.label: Mention you've been out late
topics.line: I've been out kind of late.
topics.goodText: "Just text me. That's all I ask." Loving, oblivious.

gifts.likeText: "You bought me coffee? Who raised you? Oh. Me."
